Contract:
Every top-level `##` section is wrapped with `…` markers so any agent can pull a single section via the `sdd-extract` CLI (`gennady sdd-extract `). Section order is normative: STATUS, PROBLEM, CRITERIA, OPTIONS, DECISION, CONSEQUENCES, EVIDENCE, RELATED. `OPTIONS` carries three named sub-headings in fixed order — Академия (peer-reviewed / academic treatment), Лидеры рынка (how established players solve it in production), Готовые инструменты (off-the-shelf tools/libraries) — each a real candidate, not a placeholder, per `AX_DIVERGE_BEFORE_RECOMMEND`. `EVIDENCE` holds every fact this document relies on, each re-verifiable — traced to a source (page, URL + access date; for code-derived facts, path + commit) or explicitly flagged `agent conclusion` / `from model memory as of ` (`AX_RESEARCH_PERSISTED`); a fact carrying neither is a document defect. `DECISION` states the chosen option and why; `CONSEQUENCES` the accepted trade-offs. `RELATED` links superseded research docs and the spec / ticket / Decision Log entry this research feeds.
